frame.origin: centre of the reproduced area, ground plane ('Geometry&Points' sheet)
frame.z: +z up; every point at z = 2.0 m
frame.wind_direction_rotation: meteorological FROM-direction: N = 0 blows toward -y, E = 90 toward -x; flow_dir = (-sin WD, -cos WD). The geographic frame is kept because the district is real and both the points and the STL are published in it; the 'x along the wind' convention of A-D does not apply.
frame.length_scale: FULL-scale metres (model 1:250); the official STL is model scale and is scaled x250 here

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: official BD_caseE.stl (Zenodo) scaled x250 from model to full-scale metres; 60101 triangles, 5253 boundary edges (not watertight as published)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: Eddy3D-side reconstruction from case-e.3dm, layers 'buildings' + 'buildings_new_construction', shells oriented outward

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: Eddy3D-side reconstruction of the BEFORE-construction state from case-e.3dm, layer 'buildings' only (the sites of A, B, C are empty on that layer); no published source exists for this state
